name: Gapan Christmas Open 2026
information:
Gapan Christmas Open 2026 is a World Cube Association (WCA)-sanctioned speedcubing competition to be held in Gapan City, Nueva Ecija, Philippines, in December 2026. The competition welcomes speedcubers of different ages and skill levels to participate in official WCA events, challenge themselves, and enjoy a day of sportsmanship and community.

Participants are expected to follow the official WCA Regulations and the instructions of the organizing team and delegates. Competitors should arrive on time for their scheduled events and bring their own puzzles. We look forward to welcoming everyone for an exciting celebration of speedcubing this Christmas season!
